name: Registry views check (lab only)
description: Lab-only: reads kiln.registry.view on the running server build at the world's first content ready: every view, the item member read through the advanced view and through the items registry, and the first entry of every advanced view (fields read, fields refused and why). PASS/FAIL lines and a SUMMARY in kiln.log; views-summary.json (counts per view, Kiln names only) in its data folder.
